Subject: Implementation skill-share & on-call Q&A: content index and session cadence

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our handoff checklist, I put together a compact "skill-share" package to accelerate your team's run of Redwood in production. Attached: a first-pass video index (brightline_video_index_v1.csv) mapping short clips to specific implementation topics, plus an implementation runbook PDF with troubleshooting notes.

Suggested next steps:
- Weekly 45-minute Q&A office hours for the first 6 weeks (thin scope: integration, auth, model pinning, cost controls)
- One 60-minute demo + walkthrough on week 1 to align owners and test the sample prompts
- Share short clips to your internal wiki and track outstanding questions in the shared spreadsheet

Proposed cadence (all PST):
- Week 1 onboarding walkthrough: Thu 2027-03-25 10:00–11:00
- Weekly Q&A: Thu 2027-03-25 11:15–12:00 (recurring weekly)

I attached a calendar invite (weekly_qna_cadence.ics) — happy to shift times for APAC teammates. Please let me know who on your side should be marked as "core attendees" for recordings.

Attachments: brightline_video_index_v1.csv, implementation_runbook_v1.pdf, weekly_qna_cadence.ics

Best,
Kimberly Park
